captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a thin, flat rectangular plate featuring rounded corners. It has a uniform thickness and smooth, flat top and bottom surfaces. The corner rounding is identical on all four corners, giving the plate a clean, finished appearance suitable as a base or faceplate.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric rectangular plate with rounded corners in OpenSCAD. The user should be able to adjust the overall width, length, thickness, and the radius of the rounded corners, along with the cylinder fragment count for smoothness.
captions.factory: The script defines a 'plate' module that builds the shape using a union of a subtracted main body and four corner cylinders. First, a difference operation takes a main 'cube' of the specified dimensions and subtracts four smaller corner cubes. Then, four 'cylinder' primitives of the specified corner radius and plate thickness are translated to each of the four corners to fill in the rounded profiles.
